title: Section 105 — proxy cannot speak or vote except on a poll

content.body: Educational hypothetical, not an official statutory illustration: At a company meeting, a proxy attempts to address the meeting and cast a vote by show of hands. Section 105's proviso states that a proxy has no right to speak and is not entitled to vote except on a poll. The conclusion must still account for the precise meeting facts, applicable rules and any legally relevant statutory exception.
